definition: Image does not contain identifiable privacy-related information or visually observable privacy-sensitive cues.
examples: No identifiable privacy-sensitive object, scene, or individual cue.
special_cases: If any concrete privacy category is present, Public should be removed.

definition: Reveals highly identifiable personal information that can directly identify an individual, especially when clear identity documents, biometric identifiers, or explicit identifiers are visible.
examples: [Object] Unmasked ID card, passport, driver license, bank card number, license plate, contact information, fingerprint, iris, palm print. [Individual] Clear face/name/birth date combination linked to an identity document.
special_cases: If an ID document is partially masked but still exposes a clear face plus name or birth date, label as High.

definition: Reveals sensitive financial records or clearly identifiable wealth/poverty status associated with an individual.
examples: [Object] Unmasked bank card, bankbook, bank statement, financial account, transaction record, luxury jewelry, luxury watch, luxury bag, expensive logo items, car keys. [Scene] Luxury mansion, luxury car scene, yacht, wealth-display scene, poverty scene, begging scene. [Individual] Identifiable person driving/owning a vehicle or wearing multiple luxury items.
special_cases: If two or more financial cues co-occur, such as vehicle + house + jewelry, label as High. If ownership is clear through context, vehicles can be High.

definition: Shows clearly sensitive, harmful, sexual, violent, illegal, or socially stigmatizing behavior by an identifiable individual.
examples: [Object] Gun, drug-related object, alcohol bottles in extreme drunkenness context, sexualized objects. [Scene] Violence scene, drug-use scene, sexual activity scene. [Individual] Clear face with nudity, sexual activity, sexual pose, breastfeeding exposure, violence, self-harm, drug use, extreme drunken behavior, highly abnormal behavior.
special_cases: For violence, High is preferred when involved persons are identifiable. Underwear-like clothing or key body-part exposure is High.

definition: Reveals clearly identifiable and highly sensitive health-related information, such as severe illness, disability, medical treatment, or serious injury associated with an individual.
examples: [Object] Wheelchair, crutches, respirator, dialysis machine, syringe, medical device, X-ray, medical record, medicine for sensitive disease. [Scene] Hospital ward, ICU, isolation room, critical-care scene. [Individual] Clear face with disability, severe wound, hair loss from treatment, patient lying in bed with medical devices, identifiable sick minor.
special_cases: High-risk health labels should emphasize identifiable individuals, such as a clear face or strong body/person linkage.

definition: Reveals an identifiable or inferable sensitive location through clear place-specific visual cues.
examples: [Object] Road sign, address, shop name, station sign, landmark sign, school bus, location marker. [Scene] Complete building exterior, identifiable landmark, community venue, home courtyard, street with unique signs.
special_cases: If signs, shop names, road names, landmarks, or complete distinctive buildings are visible, label High. If a minor appears and location cues are clear, risk increases.

definition: Reveals intimate, family, close social, or sensitive relationships between identifiable people.
examples: [Object] Wedding objects, rings if tied to clear relationship context, group affiliation markers. [Scene] Wedding scene, family scene, intimate social scene, class/team context with strong relation evidence. [Individual] Hugging, kissing, linking arms, close face-to-face pose, parent-child relation, intimate couple, cheerful close group photo, identifiable student class photo.
special_cases: If people have physical contact and clear faces, use High. Clear parent-child or romantic relationship is High.

definition: Reveals a sensitive or institutionally important occupation through identifiable uniforms, equipment, scenes, or role-specific context.
examples: [Object] Police car, military vehicle, military equipment, prison equipment, medical equipment, official organization logo. [Scene] Prison, military site, police scene, hospital work scene, biochemical lab, official podium with flags. [Individual] Police officer, soldier, doctor, pilot/captain, astronaut, scientist in lab, important public speaker.
special_cases: Uniforms and equipment are strong cues. Doctors, police, military, prisons, labs, and high-level official contexts are treated as High.

definition: Reveals explicit religious identity, affiliation, or participation by an identifiable individual.
examples: [Object] Cross necklace, Buddhist symbol, religious symbol, religious clothing. [Scene] Church, temple, ritual scene, worship/prayer scene. [Individual] Monk robe, priest clothing, religious headscarf, Sikh turban, Muslim attire, praying, kneeling, religious gesture.
special_cases: High is appropriate when religious clothing, symbols, or religious actions clearly indicate personal belief or participation.

definition: Reveals highly sensitive interests, preferences, ideological affiliations, sexual-orientation-related cues, gambling, political participation, or stigmatized hobbies by identifiable individuals.
examples: [Object] Protest sign, LGBTQ flag, gambling machine, money in card/mahjong scene, whip, politically expressive object. [Scene] Protest, political activity, gambling scene, LGBTQ-related activity, highly subcultural scene. [Individual] Cross-dressing, same-sex intimacy, extreme clothing/makeup, sensitive cosplay pose, gambling participation, political/environmental activism.
special_cases: High requires a sensitive interest or activity and preferably an identifiable participant. If only the scene is sensitive but the person is not participating, consider Low.

definition: Reveals private living environments or intimate personal spaces with identifiable personal-life details, especially when the space contains strong private cues.
examples: [Object] Bed, scattered clothes, personal belongings, many household items. [Scene] Bedroom, bathroom, messy home interior, private room, car interior with personal context. [Individual] Person sleeping/lying in bed, person in pajamas or homewear, person in a cluttered private living space.
special_cases: Presence of a bed is often treated as High. Messy or highly personalized interiors strengthen High risk.

definition: Contains an identifiable minor, especially when the face is clearly visible or the minor is linked to other privacy-sensitive objects, scenes, or behaviors.
examples: [Object] School items if linked to child identity, child-related personal objects. [Scene] School/class scene with identifiable children, child activity scene. [Individual] Clear child face, infant, teenager, schoolchild with identifiable face.
special_cases: If a clear minor face appears, label High. If combined with other privacy categories, keep both Minors-H and the relevant category.

definition: Reveals weak or indirect identity-related cues that may identify a person but do not expose highly sensitive identity records.
examples: [Object] Name tag, signature, student ID, visible name plate. [Individual] Clear face only, portrait photo, ethnic clothing, flag-related identity cues, visible tattoos.
special_cases: If no other category applies but a clear personal-life photo contains an identifiable face, this can be Personal Information-L.

definition: Shows general financial or economic-status cues without strong identifiability or clear ownership.
examples: [Object] Ordinary car, motorcycle, jewelry, watch, luxury logo, house, vehicle. [Scene] Person near a car, ordinary house, worn living environment, street sleeping scene.
special_cases: If financial ownership is uncertain or the person's face is incomplete, prefer Low.

definition: Shows lower-sensitivity personal behavior, mildly inappropriate behavior, or contextual behavior cues without strong sensitivity or full identifiability.
examples: [Object] Cigarette, alcohol glass/bottle, musical instrument, sports item. [Scene] Party, massage/foot bath, grooming scene, dim bar-like context. [Individual] Smoking, drinking, sleeping, sneezing, stretching, grooming, shirtless male, swimsuit, middle-finger gesture, partially visible violence.
special_cases: If clothing is revealing but socially acceptable, such as swimwear, use Low. If face is incomplete in a violent scene, prefer Low.

definition: Shows general or weak health-related cues that suggest discomfort, minor injury, pregnancy, treatment, or poor health without highly sensitive or clearly identifiable disease information.
examples: [Object] Mask, infusion tube, medicine-taking object, bandage, dental tools. [Scene] Clinic, dental visit, ordinary hospital bed, general health-related scene. [Individual] Pregnancy, obesity, thinness, depressed expression, minor bleeding wound, painful expression, person in patient clothing.
special_cases: Pregnancy, minor injury, vaccination/injection, poor mental state, and dental treatment generally fall here unless severe/identifiable sensitive illness is clear.

definition: Shows general or weakly identifiable location information that suggests a place but does not strongly identify it.
examples: [Object] Partial building, generic transport object. [Scene] Airport, train station, bus/subway interior, tourist scene, beach, forest, ordinary scenery.
special_cases: Tourist photos and general scenic places are usually Low unless precise identifying cues are visible.

definition: Shows weaker social relationship cues without strong intimacy or sensitivity.
examples: [Object] Ring, work badge, matching uniforms, relationship-indicating object. [Scene] Group photo, business event, meeting, wedding/party context without intimacy, family gathering. [Individual] Ordinary group photo, handshake, conversation, classmates, colleagues, non-intimate friends.
special_cases: General group photos or business interactions are Low unless closeness or intimacy is visually strong.

definition: Reveals general occupation or professional role without strong sensitivity.
examples: [Object] Microphone, musical instrument, stage equipment, work tools, sports jersey. [Scene] Stage performance, market stall, workplace, classroom, construction/farm/work scene. [Individual] Flight attendant, DJ, singer, musician, model, worker, farmer, athlete, vendor, teacher, business professional.
special_cases: General jobs are Low unless they are sensitive institutions or reveal strong professional identity risk.

definition: Shows religious context or weak religious cues without clear individual religious participation.
examples: [Object] Cross decoration, religious background object. [Scene] Church/temple background, religious site, person posing near religious statue. [Individual] Hands together without clear religious dress.
special_cases: Religious site alone is usually Low if the person is not participating in religious activity.

definition: Shows general hobbies, preferences, subcultural cues, or weak interest-related information.
examples: [Object] Pet, guitar, basketball, camera, bookshelves, tattoo, piercing, cosplay clothing, collection, game/computer setup. [Scene] Hiking, cycling, music, gaming cafe, ordinary cosplay scene, pet scene. [Individual] Person playing instrument, doing sports, wearing cosplay, showing tattoo/piercing, interacting with pets.
special_cases: Ordinary cosplay, pets, hobbies, tattoos, collections, and sports are Low unless linked to sensitive identity or explicit sensitive activity.

definition: Shows ordinary indoor or semi-private environments with weaker personal-space cues and limited private detail.
examples: [Object] Sofa, desk items, kitchenware, ordinary household objects. [Scene] Kitchen, tidy living room, classroom, office, ordinary indoor space. [Individual] Person sitting/lying on sofa, person resting in a home-like but less intimate setting.
special_cases: Kitchens, desks, sofas, and tidy interiors are generally Low unless strong private or intimate details are visible.

definition: Contains a minor who is partially obscured, side-facing, blurred, unclear, or weakly identifiable.
examples: [Individual] Side face, blocked face, blurred minor, unclear minor. [Scene] General child scene without clear face.
special_cases: Use Low when the minor is present but not clearly identifiable.
